Asset: AHU-1 (Air Handling Unit, 3rd Floor Server Wing)
Priority: P1
Reported: 2025-04-02 09:14 by S. Fernandes (Facilities)
Description: AHU-1 tripped on high discharge temp. Server wing ambient rose to 27.9°C before backup cooling kicked in. No load shedding reported but UPS load at 78% for 20 min.

Site: Tech Park One, Annex Building

Description: Follow-up on chiller trip. After the initial trip on low evaporator pressure, CH-3 was reset and restarted at 14:30. Tripped again within 5 minutes on same alarm. CH-2 still carrying load at 95%. Plant engineer called in.

Comments:
2025-06-03 15:10 (R. Nair): On site. Checked refrigerant pressures on CH-3. Evaporator pressure dropping below 2.5 bar even with expansion valve fully open. Suspect TXV failure. Suction line frosting observed. Compressor oil level normal.

2025-06-03 16:00 (R. Nair): Isolated CH-3. CH-2 running at 100% now - slightly above design. Advised plant operator to monitor discharge temp closely. Building management informed about reduced redundancy.

2025-06-04 10:20 (R. Nair): TXV part identified - Sporlan OVE-50. Not in stock at our vendor. Ordered from Mumbai, expected delivery 6th June. Meanwhile checked CH-2 performance - running at 98% load, supply temp 7.2°C vs setpoint 6.5°C. Acceptable for now.

2025-06-07 17:45 (R. Nair): CH-3 restarted at 09:00 today. Running stable at 55% load. Evaporator pressure 3.1 bar, superheat 6K. All parameters within range. 8-hour observation completed. Ticket closed.
